items.text: A Structured, Secure Path off Legacy Infrastructure

Azure Kubernetes Service gives regulated enterprises a controlled platform to decompose monolithic applications into microservices — eliminating the operational risk and architectural friction of enterprise cloud modernization.
Seamless Legacy Modernization

Native support for both Linux and Windows Server containers lets your legacy .NET and Java applications be containerized with minimal code refactoring — so modernization does not become a ground-up rewrite.
Unified Enterprise Governance
Direct integration with Microsoft Entra ID (Azure Active Directory) and Azure Landing Zones enforces strict compliance and identity management out of the box, across every cluster and workload.
Downtime-Free Migrations
Built-in disaster recovery, multi-region replication, and Azure Arc support enable gradual hybrid-cloud migrations — moving workloads without interrupting live operations.

items.text: Why Azure Kubernetes Service Wins vs Traditional Virtual Machines
The same workloads, run two ways. Here is what changes when you move from VM-based hosting to a managed Kubernetes platform.
Traditional Virtual Machines
Manual provisioning and patching of every server
Scale by cloning whole VMs — you pay for idle capacity
Releases require scheduled downtime and change windows
Identity and compliance bolted on machine by machine
Disaster recovery is a separate, manual project
Azure Kubernetes Service
Declarative, automated provisioning with self-healing nodes
Elastic pod autoscaling — pay only for what you run
Rolling, zero-downtime deployments by default
Microsoft Entra ID and Azure Policy enforced platform-wide
Multi-region replication and DR built into the platform

items.text: Product Differentiators That Map to Enterprise Outcomes
Every AKS capability we implement ties back to a board-level outcome: lower cost, higher stability, faster delivery, and stronger compliance.
Windows and Linux Container Support
Run .NET Framework, .NET Core, and Java side by side. Legacy Windows workloads containerize without a full rewrite, protecting years of embedded business logic.
Microsoft Entra ID Access Governance
Centralized identity, role-based access control, and conditional access are enforced at the cluster level — ending the per-server identity sprawl of a VM estate.
Azure Landing Zone Alignment
Clusters are deployed inside your enterprise-scale landing zone, inheriting network, policy, and compliance guardrails from day one.
Azure Arc Hybrid Management
Govern on-premises, AKS, and multi-cloud Kubernetes from a single control plane while your workloads migrate at a pace the business controls.
Multi-Region Disaster Recovery
Active-passive or active-active replication keeps regulated workloads available through regional failures and planned maintenance.
Azure DevOps Release Gates
CI/CD pipelines with automated release gates promote builds through environments with approvals, automated tests, and rollback baked in.
